'''Josh Clark''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 8 from Brazil, In. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Clark also played [[Young Jedi]]. He won YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck), and finished 5th in the Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs) and 9th in YJ Constructed Deck.<ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105010700/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj12_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ12_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Constructed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001009054101/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ12_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
